description: Stationnement vélo en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by © Les contributeurs OpenStreetMap. Couche géographique décrivant les emplacements de stationnement pour vélo en Île-de-France: arceaux, râtelier, stations Véligo... Généalogie Ces données sont issues du crowdsourcing effectué par les contributeurs au projet OpenStreetMap et sont sous licence ODbL et la mention d'attribution doit être "© les contributeurs d'OpenStreetMap sous licence ODbL" conformément à Dans le cadre du recensement des ... Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Vélo, Aménagement, Stationnement, Aménagements cyclables, IDG, geoidf. The portal shows 27,311 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
